before.name: Reduction in landfill-bound waste vs 2005
before.source: NYC Department of Sanitation, DSNY Monthly Tonnage Data (NYC Open Data dataset ebb7-mvp5), aggregated via Socrata SoQL sum of refusetonscollected where borough='Bronx', grouped by calendar year

scoring.worked_math: Baseline: Bronx DSNY-collected refuse ('landfill-bound' waste per OneNYC 0x30 / Zero Waste Act framing), CY2005 = sum of refusetonscollected across all Bronx community/sanitation districts, 132 district-month records = 513,421.85 tons. Current: CY2025 (most recent complete calendar year; data available through 2026-07) = same 132 district-month records = 478,703.47 tons. Reduction = (513,421.85 − 478,703.47) / 513,421.85 × 100 = 34,718.38 / 513,421.85 × 100 = 6.76%. level_pct = (90 − 6.76) / 90 × 100 = +92.49

after.name: Reduction in DSNY-collected refuse tonnage vs 2005 (disposal proxy)
after.source: NYC Department of Sanitation — Monthly Tonnage Data
after.notes: CY2005:556777.75 tons; CY2025:520903.27 tons. 144/144 unique district-month records;12 months each. Fiscalyears run Jul–Jun; calendaryears Jan–Dec. The configured landfill-bound metric is not exact: DSNY refuse collected is a disposal proxy and excludes commercial/private collection. Existing 90% target is retained only as context; no proxy score asserted. Original Bronx calculation omitted January; full year reduction 6.44%.
